tldr: Claude Opus 5.5 shipped Sep 22, an hour before OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna, and the launch coincided with 40-50% price cuts across vendors. Sonnet 5.5 followed Sep 28 on AWS with a lower cost per task.
whats_new: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrived Oct 7 and AINews rates it better than GPT-6 Luna at the same pricing, completing the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku 5.5 lineup.
why_it_matters: The 5.5 family now covers all three tiers, so model-routing and cost-per-task evals can be rerun across Opus, Sonnet and Haiku against the new price floor.

status.detail: Opus, Sonnet and Haiku 5.5 are all released.

beats.headline: Opus 5.5 ships alongside GPT-6 Sol and Luna; vendors cut prices 40-50%
beats.summary: A same-day OpenAI release set off a price war.

beats.headline: Anthropic details what tasks cost on Opus 5.5
beats.summary: Per-task cost, not token price, is the framing.

beats.headline: Sonnet 5.5 lands on AWS; Opus 5.5 gets hands-on praise

open_questions: Does Haiku 5.5 hold its edge over GPT-6 Luna at equal price on independent evals?
Do the Sep 22 vendor price cuts hold through Q4?
take_for_builders: Rerun your routing evals with Haiku 5.5 on the cheap tier and compare cost per completed task, not per-token price, against Sonnet 5.5.
